chapter: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas
act_title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas

quests.title: Eight Locales Over Mountains and Seas

dialogue.t: Hey there, Ioroi!
Eeek! You saw through me? How did... Wait, no, this scent...
Ah, so it's you. It has been so long, I could not recognize your scent!
And you haven't changed at all, Ioroi — still scared of humans and stuck in a stone!
Mmm!? What do you mean by that?

dialogue.sit: Hope your seal can be lifted soon.
Paimon means that we hope that your seal will soon be lifted.

dialogue.t: Bah, it is but a human seal! If I were but to try harder...

dialogue.sit: *cough*

dialogue.t: Well. Regardless, I see you have taken good care of the little ones. My little tanuki often say that they enjoy playing with their nice-smelling yellow-furred Aunt(Uncle).

dialogue.sit: Yellow-furred Aunt(Uncle)...
Nice-smelling...
Also, it's not Aunt(Uncle). It's Big Sis(Big Bro).

dialogue.t: And here I had thought that humans were all the same as that fellow who had us sealed — wicked and scary. But it seems that there are still some good eggs amongst you.

dialogue.sit: Most people are alright.
Why, thank you.

dialogue.t: That's right. Most of the people we've met are good people! You got sealed because you stole that comb...
Hmph! And I've returned it! So if you ever meet that fellow who learned magic from Reizenbou, tell him to get me out of this stone!
Mmph! When you get down to it, everything is that sneaky kitsune's fault...
(Ioroi really complains like some old geezer, huh?)

dialogue.sit: (Well, he is quite old.)

dialogue.t: Well then, neither your hands nor legs are made of stone, so you've been to many places, surely?
Yup! We came right over the ocean, you know?

dialogue.sit: You tell Ioroi about your adventures in Mondstadt and Liyue.

dialogue.t: ...So, there are so many lands abroad. Very impressive.
I have been subsisting off reports from the little tanuki all this while, and so do not know what the outside world is like.

Once upon a time, I stood at the summit of Mt. Yougou and saw a very, very high mountain on the other side of the ocean. It was possibly even taller than Mt. Yougou. I still wonder, even today, what that place was.

dialogue.sit: Across the ocean, you say...
From the direction you're referring to, that's probably Dragonspine.

dialogue.t: That's gotta be Dragonspine, right?
Mmmm, Dragonspine? Just thinking about that name makes my tummy feel cold. Goodness knows why that fellow wants to go there...
As I said earlier, you are fine folk, yes? So...
Paimon can smell this request coming a mile away!

Mmm! Even like this, I am still the Hidden Protector of the Grove, defender of Chinju Forest, and thusly appointed by Her Excellency herself! If I was not sealed in stone, I would certainly use an eight-tatami large...

dialogue.sit: Alright then. What do you need help with?
Well...

dialogue.t: Though I cannot move on my own power, the little children can do so. As such, I would like to ask you to take the little tanuki out to train.
Take Kichiboushi with you. He has been quite eager to see you since the last time you played together — quite eager indeed!

dialogue.sit: Well, we can do that...
One question, if you would...

dialogue.t: That's true. We can't understand what Kichiboushi says, so wouldn't traveling together be kinda tough?
Impossible. We tanuki understand human speech by nature. It is you humans who do not speak ours.
What? Is that how it is?

dialogue.sit: But as travel companions...
We'd like to chat as we travel, you know?

dialogue.t: Just like Paimon does with {NICKNAME}!
Mmph. Very well then. Now that I consider it, didn't someone once use our magic to make you some food?
Now, I may look like this, but making you a "meal" that can allow you to understand Kichiboushi's speech is hardly impossible nonetheless.
Woo-hoo! Food!

dialogue.sit: Is it gonna taste good, though...

dialogue.t: Now, now, don't you underestimate my culinary prowess!

dialogue.sit:
Although you can't be sure where Ioroi got it from...
You and Paimon have a feast that "looks very delicious" off Ioroi's stone tummy.

dialogue.t: Ooh, this is great!
Of course. I am Ioroi, you know — the very same who once made Sashimi Platters out of mud balls and tanuki fur to utterly deceive the Four Oni of Ogata!
That's awesome, Ioroi! But so, what did you make the meal we just had out of?

dialogue.sit: Some questions are best left unasked, Paimon.

dialogue.t: Huh?
Well, forget it. Let's go find Kichiboushi and have a chat!
Hey there, Kichiboushi! Long time no see!
Mm! White Fur, Yellow Fur.

dialogue.sit: I guess "Yellow Fur" must be me?

dialogue.t: Who're you calling White Fur?
Mm, very strong. Can understand.

dialogue.sit: I'm {NICKNAME}, and this is Paimon.

dialogue.t: And you'd better remember that!
Squelch squelch Lavender Melon.
What? Lavender Melon? And what's "squelch squelch" supposed to mean?
Well, at least we can kinda-sorta communicate...

dialogue.sit: "Kinda-sorta" is kinda-sorta right.

dialogue.t: Whatever the case, {NICKNAME}, let's go back and see Ioroi again. We are taking Kichiboushi out on a long journey, after all.
Ioroi! Yey!
Yey!
Through the power of the bake-danuki meal made by mine own hands, you, too, may speak to the little tanuki. Go, try having a chat with Kichiboushi.

dialogue.sit: We'll do that.

dialogue.t: Go, then, go. I have all the time in the world to go nowhere, but it is not so with my little tanuki.
Mm! How goes it?
Mm! See White Fur, Yellow Fur, very happy. Lavender Melon Kapow!

dialogue.sit: Lavender Melon Kapow...

dialogue.t: Hmm, quite the bright spark, aren't you?
Kapow!

dialogue.sit: So, what does Lavender Melon Kapow mean again...?

dialogue.t: Kapow is Kapow. Lavender Melon is Lavender Melon.
Well, it seems that communications have been established without any problems. Ah, mine "culinary" skills are as fine as ever!

dialogue.sit: ...I suppose so?
..."Without any problems," he says...

dialogue.t: Nope, not at all! We can't understand a thing Kichiboushi's saying!
Well, Ioroi, here's the thing...

dialogue.sit: You tell Ioroi how the attempted interactions are going...

dialogue.t: Mmm, so that's how it is. Not to worry. It is because you are not yet used to Kichiboushi's aura.
Take it slow! The more used to his aura you are, the better you shall understand him!
How slow are we talking about here?
Ah, hmm. Let me think about that...
Eh! Whatever the case, do not be in a rush!
Rush no good.

dialogue.sit: You don't know either, do you?

dialogue.t: Hmph! I will have you know that I am Ioroi, the long-lived king of bake-danuki! I simply do not put such premiums on time as you humans do.
(Even though he's spent most of his time sealed in that stone statue...)

dialogue.sit: Then why can you speak to humans just fine, Ioroi?

dialogue.t: Mmph! Such impertinence! Rather, you should ask why you humans may speak to us.
Having lived as long and become as powerful as I have, I have had at least some interactions with humanity.

A long, long time ago, I often spoke with tengu, kitsune, oni, youkai, and humans alike. And while human stories often concern themselves, at least half of them involve bake-danuki who transformed into humans.
Half of the remaining half are indeed about humans themselves, and the other half are about all the other youkai.
But even in this half, a good half concern we tanuki, who clad ourselves in the guise of the other youkai. Then half again of the tanuki tales are those concerning me.
Mmph, as such, you may see that I am the greatest of them all. Naturally, speaking to you young ones is no tall order at all.

dialogue.sit: I get it. Five over sixteen to Ioroi, yes?

dialogue.t: Mm? What's "Five Over Sixteen"? Is it something that one may eat?
Sounds delicious. Want to eat.
{NICKNAME}'s referring to the percentage of stories that you're involved in, Ioroi.
Ioroi. Powerful!
Hah, why of course! You have much to learn from my powers, you do.
Eh? Come to think of it, we're starting to get what Kichiboushi is saying, aren't we?
White Fur smart.
That might have been praise, but Paimon sure doesn't feel good about it.
Good, good. Then I leave this child in your hands. Take him to go see the world and train!

Why, when I was but a young tanuki, I too went on a pilgrimage to eighteen sites in Inazuma along the trail of the great bake-danuki Tsukumo, never once straying from the tanuki paths — only thus did I reach my present stature.
Eh? Is that why you were sealed in stone?
Mm-haha! Stone!
Eh!? You too, Kichiboushi...?
Ahem! So, uh, back on topic! Where should we go first?

dialogue.sit: There's that place Ioroi mentioned earlier...
How does Dragonspine sound?

dialogue.t: Uh-huh! Dragonspine it is, then!
"If there's a mountain, we shall climb it" — ah, Paimon's been waiting for a chance to say something cool like that!
Mountain, there!
Oooh, that sounds cold... Don't let your tummy get cold now, Kichiboushi. You'll catch a cold otherwise, and if you do, you won't be able to perform using your belly drum.
Also, remember to eat properly and follow Aunt(Uncle) Yellow Fur like a good boy.
Understand! Following Aunt(Uncle) Yellow Fur!

dialogue.sit: We'll take good care of Kichiboushi, don't worry.
Don't you worry.
It's not Aunt(Uncle). It's Big Sis(Big Bro).

dialogue.t: Pleased to meet you, Kichiboushi!
Mm! No worry! Kichiboushi take care of you!
Hmm, looks like we're not completely getting through to him...

quests.description: You have not gone to see Ioroi of Chinju Forest for quite some time now. Perhaps it’s time to pay the sealed king of bake-danuki a visit…
